items.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
items.creator: J.K. Rowling
items.excerpt: An 11-year-old orphan discovers he is a famous wizard and goes to Hogwarts to learn magic, make friends, and protect a magical stone.
items.body:
Harry Potter is an 11-year-old orphan who lives with his mean aunt, uncle, and cousin. On his birthday, he discovers a big secret: he is a famous wizard!

Harry goes to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry to learn magic. There, he makes two best friends, Ron and Hermione, and learns how to fly on a broomstick. He also discovers a magical sport called Quidditch.

The story gets exciting when Harry and his friends find out that someone is trying to steal the Sorcerer's Stone — a magical object that can give eternal life. Harry must use his courage and his friends' help to protect the stone from the dark wizard Voldemort.

I love this book because it's full of adventure and friendship. Harry teaches us that even when things seem impossible, courage and friends can help us through.

items.title: The Little Prince
items.creator: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
items.excerpt: A little boy travels from one planet to another and learns about life, love, and friendship.
items.body:
The Little Prince is a beautiful story about a young boy who travels from one planet to another, meeting interesting characters along the way.

What makes this book so special is its simple but deep message: the most important things in life cannot be seen with the eyes. You have to feel them with your heart.

This book taught me the value of friendship and understanding others. Even though it looks like a children's book, it has lessons for everyone — no matter their age.

I recommend it to anyone who wants a gentle, thoughtful, and touching story.

items.title: Moana
items.creator: Walt Disney Animation
items.excerpt: A brave girl sails across the ocean to save her island. Along the way, she meets new friends and faces many challenges.
items.body:
Do you like adventure and exciting journeys? Then you should watch Moana!

It is a story about a brave girl who sails across the ocean to save her island. Along the way, she meets new friends and faces many challenges.

You will learn about courage, friendship, and believing in yourself. Will Moana succeed in her mission? Watch the story and find out!

items.title: Neil Armstrong
items.creator: A biography
items.excerpt: The inspiring story of the first man on the moon. From his childhood dreams to leading the Gemini 8 mission.
items.body:
Neil Armstrong was born on August 5, 1930. His family lived in 20 towns when he was a boy!

When Neil turned six, his dad took him for his first plane ride in a Tin Goose. It was a plane that had three motors. Neil knew that he would one day be a pilot.

At 15, Neil took part-time jobs in three stores. A flying lesson cost $9 an hour. He had to work 21 hours to earn just one lesson. He spent a year learning to fly and earned his pilot's license at the age of 16.

Neil joined the U.S. Navy and flew planes in the Korean War. He was known for being brave. The U.S. Navy sent him to college, where he took classes to learn about flying in space. After college, Neil went to work at NASA.

In 1966, Neil led the Gemini 8 mission. He and David Scott blasted off to dock their craft with an unmanned rocket in space. But something went wrong — they started to spin out of control. Neil stayed calm and fixed the problem, and Gemini 8 landed safely in the Pacific Ocean.

Neil's story teaches us that hard work, courage, and staying calm under pressure can take us anywhere — even to the moon.

items.title: Rapunzel (Tangled)
items.creator: Walt Disney Animation
items.excerpt: A curious girl locked in a tower with 70 feet of golden hair escapes to discover the world and her true identity.
items.body:
Rapunzel may have lived her entire life locked inside a hidden tower, but Rapunzel is no damsel in distress!

The girl with 70 feet of golden hair is an energetic, inquisitive teenager who fills her days with art, books, and imagination. Rapunzel is full of curiosity about the outside world, and she can't help but feel that her true destiny lies outside of the lonely tower walls.

When her 18th birthday draws near, she is finally old enough to leave the tower and discovers the world she's only read about in books. Along with a charming thief named Flynn Rider, Rapunzel sets out on a journey full of humor, heart, and hair-raising adventures.

I love this movie because Rapunzel is brave, funny, and never gives up. It's a beautiful story about following your dreams.

items.title: Home Alone
items.creator: 20th Century Fox
items.excerpt: A clever boy is left home alone during the holidays and must defend his house from two clumsy burglars.
items.body:
Home Alone is a funny, action-packed movie that the whole family can enjoy.

Kevin McCallister is a clever 8-year-old boy who gets left behind when his family goes on a Christmas trip. At first, he loves having the house to himself — but then two burglars try to break in.

Kevin uses his imagination and clever tricks to defend his house from the burglars. The traps he sets are hilarious and brilliant.

But underneath the funny moments, Home Alone is also a story about family, love, and how much we miss the people we care about. I recommend it for a fun family movie night!

items.title: Zootopia
items.creator: Walt Disney Animation
items.excerpt: In a city of animals, a rabbit police officer teams up with a clever fox to solve a mystery.
items.body:
Salama recommends Zootopia — a film set in a city of animals, where a determined rabbit police officer teams up with a clever fox to solve a big mystery.

Take a look at Salama's poster above!

items.title: The Secret Garden
items.creator: Frances Hodgson Burnett
items.excerpt: The emotional and physical healing of a spoiled, orphaned girl named Mary Lennox.
items.body:
This book is about the emotional and physical healing of a spoiled, orphaned girl named Mary Lennox. Read this book and find out more about it.

The Secret Garden teaches that positive thinking, nature, and nurturing relationships can transform physical and emotional health, shifting one from despair to joy.

items.title: Stranger Things
items.creator: TV series
items.excerpt: A group of friends search for their missing friend Will and discover the Upside Down.
items.body:
Stranger Things is a story about four friends named Mike, Will, Lucas, and Dustin. One day, their friend Will goes missing. They team up with a special girl named Eleven and discover a scary monster from a dark world called the Upside Down.

Things get stranger in their town as they search for Will and try to defeat the dangers of the Upside Down.

items.title: Thomas Edison
items.creator: A biography
items.excerpt: The inventor of the electric light bulb, the phonograph and the motion picture camera.
items.body:
Thomas Edison (1847–1931) was an American inventor and businessman who developed many key inventions of modern life, including the electric light bulb, the phonograph and the motion picture camera. He filed over 1,000 patents!

He attended only three months of formal school, but he never stopped asking questions. As he said, genius is one per cent inspiration and ninety-nine per cent perspiration.

items.title: Tinker Bell
items.creator: Walt Disney Animation
items.excerpt: A tiny fairy discovers her special talent for fixing and inventing things.
items.body:
Tinker Bell is a tiny fairy who lives in the magical world of Never Land. She discovers her special talent: fixing and inventing things, which makes her a "tinker" fairy.

At first, Tink feels jealous of the fairies with flashier powers and tries to change who she is. Her experiments go wrong, but her friends remind her that every talent matters. When a big problem threatens the fairies, Tink uses her clever inventions to help save the day.

Moral: Everyone has a unique talent to help others.
